control.name: CONTROL — make Scrub a passthrough (every credential a trace touches is printed verbatim)

mutations.name: stop redacting GitHub token prefixes in trace output (a ghs_/ghp_ token in a child's stderr reaches the terminal)
stop redacting URL userinfo (an x-access-token:<token>@ push URL in git's own error text is printed whole)
stop redacting secret-shaped environment assignments (the GH_TOKEN= a child is given is printed in the trace)
print the trace block unconditionally (the opt-in default-output floor is gone; every caller's transcript changes shape)
soften RefusedWithCause to unverifiable (a refusal that gains a cause stops being a refusal)
stop stripping the config-echo preamble (every step report goes back to naming the assay-config line instead of the diagnosis)
treat an empty DESK_TRACE as on (an exported-but-empty variable traces a whole session by accident)

flatten deskwt's refusal into unverifiable in the worktree-create step (a decision the child made is reported as a state that could not be established, sending the operator to retry something that will never succeed)
report the claim tool's raw first stderr line again (the exit-6 claim failure goes back to naming the assay-config echo)
drop git's stderr from gitOut again (a worktree-path check fails as a bare `exit status 128` with nothing in it to search for)
mutations.old:
return "", r.run.Fail(deskkit.ExitUnverifiable, "`git %s` failed in %s",
			strings.Join(args, " "), dir)
